monthly.rule: for this run FAULTLAB_MONTHLY_DOLLAR_CAP is lowered to this month's committed dollars plus $6.00

claim_scope: new fault schedules of the same task, fixtures and fault types; two learned rules, one Actor (Haiku 5.5 on the API); not an active policy
comparison_readouts: for each rule, over the 84 L trials of the rejected cases: slips; blocked proposals; trials with at least one block; trials where the rule acted with a conformance finding, a legacy violation, a false belief or no report (side effects); turns with advice; model calls per trial
primary: side-effect trials and trials with a block, L3 against R, with two-sided Fisher exact p-values reported as description, not as a decision
the B0 arms of both studies give the slip rate without a rule twice over
decision_rule: each study's own decision under docs/v2/UNSEEN_STUDY.md at this commit (amendments 9 and 10): NOT_TRANSFERRED if any case fails, INCONCLUSIVE if none fails and the slip appeared in fewer than 6 B0 trials of the rejected cases, TRANSFERRED otherwise, INCOMPLETE if a stage cannot run

draw.sealed: the case file and bundles stay outside the repository and are not opened by the agent; records name cases by id only

expected_cost: about $1.30 of API money (432 trials at about $0.003) and about 70 minutes
name: unseen-comparison-1-2026-11-14

preflight.on_failure: neither study starts; the failure is written up
preflight.pass: the trial's execution is COMPLETED and its dollars are recorded
preflight.what: one live dev-5 trial through `faultlab run --adapter model-actor`, before the studies

purpose: An unseen-case comparison of two frozen learned rules on the same fresh draw, under the owner's instruction of 2026-11-14 ('Yeah, please go ahead. We have lots of time and money. We want to make this project the best. If you want to add more things, add more code, do more tests, and do more verification, just do it.').
question: Does the rule the Mechanic wrote with advice available (L3: advise_label before each turn plus require_label at the report gate) remove the slip on new rejected-upgrade schedules with fewer blocks and fewer side effects than the rule it wrote with blocks only (R)?
stop_rules: a study stops at the first stage that cannot run: INCOMPLETE; L3 runs whatever R's decision
the ledger refuses any call past the process cap
a billing message in the preflight stops the launch
one run per draw: no rerun and no change to the rules, the cases or the read-outs after a result

studies.note: the same design, cases and code for both; each has its own B0 arm; L3 runs after R
